00062 #define UnaryOpUGenConstructor(INTERNALUGENCLASSNAME, OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL, operand_)                      \
00063     initInternal(operand_.getNumChannels());                                        \
00064     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)                                       \
00065     {                                                           \
00066       internalUGens[i] = new INTERNALUGENCLASSNAME(operand_);                               \
00067       internalUGens[i]->initValue(ugen::OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(operand_.getValue(i)));                   \

00070 #define UnaryOpUGenProcessBlock(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL)                     \
00071     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                                  \
00072     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                                    \
00073     float* inputSamples = inputs[Operand].processBlock(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_);                  \
00074                                                                 \
00075       while(numSamplesToProcess--)                                            \
00076       {                                                         \
00077         *outputSamples++ = OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*inputSamples++);                            \
00078       }                                                         \
00079 
00080 #define UnaryOpUGenProcessBlock_K(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL)                   \
00081     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();                                \
00082     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;                                   \
00083     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                                  \
00084     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                                    \
00085     float* inputSamples = inputs[Operand].processBlock(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_);                  \
00086                                                                 \
00087     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;                                     \
00088                                                                 \
00089       while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                                          \
00090         float nextValue = value;                                            \
00091         if(numKrSamples == 0) nextValue = OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*inputSamples);                     \
00092                                                                 \
00093         numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;                                    \
00094                                                                 \
00095         blockPosition   += numKrSamples;                                      \
00096         inputSamples    += numKrSamples;                                      \
00097                                                                 \
00098         if(nextValue == value) {                                            \
00099           while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                                \
00100             *outputSamples++ = nextValue;                                     \
00101             --numSamplesToProcess;                                          \
00102             --numKrSamples;                                             \
00103           }                                                     \
00104         } else {                                                    \
00105           float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) / (float)UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();              \
00106           while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                                \
00107             *outputSamples++ = value;                                       \
00108             value += valueSlope;                                          \
00109             --numSamplesToProcess;                                          \
00110             --numKrSamples;                                             \
00111           }                                                     \
00112           value = nextValue;                                              \
00113         }                                                       \
00114       }                                                         \

00247     Buffer Buffer::OPFUNCTION() const throw()                                       \
00248     {                                                           \
00249       Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, numChannels_, false));                             \
00250                                                                 \
00251       for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < numChannels_; channelIndex++)                        \
00252       {                                                         \
00253         int numSamples = size_;                                             \
00254         float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data;                               \
00255         float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                          \
00256                                                                 \
00257         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                            \
00258           *outputSamples++ = ugen::OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*inputSamples++);                        \
00259         }                                                       \
00260       }                                                         \
00261                                                                 \
00262       return newBuffer;                                                 \
00263     }                                                           \

00368 template<UnaryOpFunction op>
00369 class UnaryOpUGenInternalT : public UnaryOpUGenInternal
00370 {
00371 public:
00372   UnaryOpUGenInternalT(UGen const& operand)
00373   : UnaryOpUGenInternal(operand)
00374   {
00375   }
00376   
00377   UGenInternal* getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00378   {
00379     return new UnaryOpUGenInternalT<op>(inputs[Operand].getChannel(channel));
00380   }
00381   
00382   UGenInternal* getKr() throw();
00383   
00384   float getValue(const int channel) const throw()                   
00385   {                                                         
00386     return op(inputs[Operand].getValue(channel));   
00387   }   
00388   
00389   void processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw() 
00390   { 
00391     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); 
00392     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData(); 
00393     const float* operandSamples = inputs[Operand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00394     
00395     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00396     {
00397       *outputSamples++ = (float)op((float)*operandSamples);
00398     }
00399   }
00400 };

00402 template<UnaryOpFunction op>
00403 class UnaryOpUGenInternalTK : public UnaryOpUGenInternalT<op>
00404 {
00405 private:
00406   float value;
00407   
00408 public:
00409   UnaryOpUGenInternalTK(UGen const& operand) throw()
00410   : UnaryOpUGenInternalT<op>(operand), value(0.f)
00411   {
00412     this->rate = UGenInternal::ControlRate;
00413   }
00414   
00415   UGenInternal* getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00416   {
00417     return new UnaryOpUGenInternalTK<op>(this->inputs[UnaryOpUGenInternal::Operand].getChannel(channel));
00418   }
00419   
00420   UGenInternal* getKr() throw() { this->incrementRefCount(); return this; } 
00421   
00422   void processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw() 
00423   {
00424     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();                                
00425     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;                                   
00426     int numSamplesToProcess = this->uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                                  
00427     float* outputSamples = this->uGenOutput.getSampleData();                                  
00428     float* inputSamples = this->inputs[UnaryOpUGenInternal::Operand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);                  
00429     
00430     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;                                     
00431     
00432     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                                          
00433       float nextValue = value;                                            
00434       if(numKrSamples == 0) nextValue = op(*inputSamples);                      
00435       
00436       numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;                                    
00437       
00438       blockPosition   += numKrSamples;                                      
00439       inputSamples    += numKrSamples;                                      
00440       
00441       if(nextValue == value) {                                            
00442         while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                                
00443           *outputSamples++ = nextValue;                                     
00444           --numSamplesToProcess;                                          
00445           --numKrSamples;                                             
00446         }                                                     
00447       } else {                                                    
00448         float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) / (float)UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();              
00449         while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                                
00450           *outputSamples++ = value;                                       
00451           value += valueSlope;                                          
00452           --numSamplesToProcess;                                          
00453           --numKrSamples;                                             
00454         }                                                     
00455         value = nextValue;                                              
00456       }                                                       
00457     }                                                             
00458   }
00459 };

00480 template<UnaryOpFunction op>
00481 class UnaryOpUGenT : public UGen
00482 {
00483 public:
00484   UnaryOpUGenT(UGen const& operand, UGen const& rightOperand) throw()
00485   {
00486     initInternal(operand.getNumChannels()); 
00487     
00488     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++) 
00489     { 
00490       internalUGens[i] = new UnaryOpUGenInternalT<op>(operand);
00491       internalUGens[i]->initValue(op(operand.getValue(i)));
00492     }
00493     
00494   }
00495   
00496   static UGen AR(UGen const& operand) { return UnaryOpUGenT<op>(operand); }
00497   static UGen KR(UGen const& operand) { return UGen(UnaryOpUGenT<op>(operand).kr()).kr(); }
00498 };
